events.invalidation: Trim/median leave 1.9–2.0% higher and CORRA 2027 implieds hold at or above the 3.40% strip / 3.13% Mar-27 entry because BoC delivers the priced catch-up.
events.rationale: VERIFIED FACT: CORRA is 2.29% (2026-09-17); CRA 2027 contracts imply 3.13–3.595% (strip avg 3.40%); Canada August CPI-trim 1.9%, CPI-median 2.0%, headline 3.0%; employment −42k, wages +2.0% y/y, unemployment 6.4%; Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75–4.00% and SOFR printed 3.85% ACT/360; US 2Y 4.76% vs CA 2Y 3.27% = −140bp; Saudi STS workaround modestly eased oil. INFERENCE: the 84–130bp of 2027 BoC tightening is the market paying up for an energy-pass-through/Fed-catch-up narrative that labor and core have not validated; implied-minus-realized on a patient 2027 receiver is the carry. The same view in spot is long USDCAD (140bp 2Y), but AUDCAD is already a 5y extreme and CAD shorts are covering, so rates is cleaner. UNKNOWN: whether headline energy pass-through lifts trim/median enough to force the priced hikes; CA official curve and executable mids are absent. Reject paying CAD or buying stretched AUDCAD; those theses do not pay their carry.
